photos.title: Multnomah Falls
photos.blurb: Two drops and the bridge between them.
photos.story: Multnomah Falls drops 620 feet in two tiers, the tallest in Oregon. Benson Bridge crosses between them.

photos.title: Sahalie Falls
photos.blurb: Mist and moss where the river drops.
photos.story: Sahalie Falls drops over a lava shelf on the upper McKenzie. Koosah Falls is a short walk downstream.

trails.title: Obsidian
trails.summary: A short high-country walk. Two stops so far.

trails.title: McKenzie River
trails.summary: Down the river, starting at the falls.
trails.story: The McKenzie runs west from Clear Lake through lava and forest toward the Willamette Valley.

trails.title: Columbia Gorge
trails.story: The Columbia River cuts through the Cascades here. Creeks fall off the Oregon cliffs in a long line of waterfalls.
